title: IoT-based Anti-theft Flooring System
blurb: Smart floor with hidden pressure sensors to detect intruders and send alerts via IoT.

details.how: Pressure sensors under floor tiles detect unusual footsteps. Data is sent to ESP32 or Raspberry Pi, which checks thresholds and triggers alarms. The system sends real-time alerts to a mobile app or Node-RED dashboard using MQTT/Blynk.
details.tech: ESP32 or Raspberry Pi, Pressure Sensors (FSR/Load Cell), MQTT broker, Blynk App or Node-RED dashboard, Arduino IDE/Python
features: Scalable – multiple floor sensors in different rooms
Can connect with sirens, cameras, or smart locks
components: Force Sensitive Resistors (FSR) or load cell sensors
Power supply (5V USB adapter or battery)
Optional: Camera module for Raspberry Pi

title: IoT Virtual Doctor Robot
blurb: A telemedicine robot with health sensors and live video streaming for remote consultation.

details.how: The robot is equipped with ESP32-CAM for video streaming and sensors (temperature, heart rate, SpO2). Data is transmitted to a cloud server or mobile app. Doctors can remotely monitor and interact with patients via dashboard.
details.tech: ESP32-CAM, Raspberry Pi, MQTT, Flask/Django backend, Blynk/Node-RED dashboard

title: IoT Contactless Doorbell
blurb: A touch-free smart doorbell using motion sensors and IoT notifications.

details.how: A PIR motion sensor detects presence near the door. Instead of pressing a button, the detection triggers a doorbell sound and sends an IoT notification to the homeowner’s phone.
details.tech: Raspberry Pi/ESP32, PIR motion sensor, MQTT broker, Blynk/IFTTT integration
features: Mobile alerts when someone is at the door
Integration with cameras for visitor snapshots
Works even during COVID/health safety conditions

title: IoT Smart Parking System
blurb: Smart parking management using IoT sensors for real-time slot availability.

details.how: Ultrasonic sensors detect vehicle presence in each slot. Data is uploaded to a cloud dashboard via MQTT. Users can check available parking slots on a mobile app.

title: IoT Weather Reporting System
blurb: A real-time IoT-based weather monitoring system with temperature, humidity, and pressure data.

details.how: Sensors measure environmental parameters like temperature, humidity, and pressure. ESP32 uploads data to ThingSpeak/Node-RED dashboards for visualization and alerts.
details.tech: ESP32, DHT11/22 sensor, BMP180/BME280 sensor, MQTT, ThingSpeak

title: IoT Water Level Monitoring System
blurb: Monitors water levels in tanks and sends alerts when full/empty.

details.how: An ultrasonic sensor measures water level in a tank. ESP8266 uploads data to Blynk app, which notifies users if the tank is full or empty.
details.tech: ESP8266, Ultrasonic sensor, Blynk app, Arduino IDE

title: IoT-based Home Automation
blurb: Control home appliances remotely using IoT and voice assistants.

details.how: Appliances are connected via relay modules controlled by ESP32. Mobile apps or voice assistants like Alexa/Google Home can switch devices ON/OFF through IoT platforms.
details.tech: ESP32, Relay module, Blynk app, MQTT broker, Google Assistant/Alexa integration

title: IoT Smart Agriculture Monitoring System
blurb: Monitors soil, humidity, and temperature for smart agriculture applications.

details.how: Sensors collect soil moisture, temperature, and humidity data. ESP32 sends it to Node-RED dashboard via MQTT. Automated irrigation and alerts help farmers improve productivity.
details.tech: ESP32, Soil moisture sensor, DHT11 sensor, MQTT, Node-RED/Blynk
features: Improves crop yield and saves water

title: Women Safety Night Patrolling IoT Robot
blurb: An IoT-enabled patrolling robot for women’s safety with live video, GPS tracking, and SOS alerts.

details.how: The robot is equipped with ESP32-CAM for surveillance, GPS for tracking, and GSM for SOS alerts. Controlled via IoT dashboard, it patrols predefined areas and sends live updates.
details.tech: Raspberry Pi, ESP32-CAM, GPS module, GSM module, Node-RED dashboard
features: Can integrate with police monitoring systems
